status: Research and design only; no native build, device installation, multiplayer measurement, or art-rig implementation.
confirmed_decisions: 1–4 human family players across iPad, iPhone and Android.
Android device supplied: SM-S948U1; identified by Samsung as Galaxy S26 Ultra; installed Android version not supplied.
Every player may choose any available character, including playable Bandit and Chilli; no parent/child restrictions.
Keep two child-owned bedrooms and secret rooms; parent visitors do not replace owners.
proposed_architecture: One game project with platform-specific builds and discovery adapters, common protocol and save schema.
PC preferred at home; one stable eligible mobile host away; automatic family joining after setup.
Four independent profiles, dynamic activity participants, atomic admission and object reservations.
Human character choice separate from NPC actor and activity role; duplicate favorites supported.
Full solo offline fallback; custom snapshot/event recovery and branch reconciliation.
requires_physical_tests: Installed Android version and permission behavior.
A10 performance with four humans and independent zones.
Both iPads as host; Android and iPhone hosting candidates.
Actual hotspot provider also playing; mixed client routing and discovery.
Host loss with three surviving clients; four returning offline branches.

sources.title: Unity NGO supported platforms
sources.finding: NGO 2.13 documentation lists Unity 6+, iOS and Android support; does not certify this game or its capacity.

sources.title: Unity connection approval
sources.finding: Connection approval hooks support an application-defined admission policy. Four humans is our design target, not an engine limit.

sources.title: Android network service discovery
sources.finding: NsdManager implements DNS-SD with cross-platform discovery and multiplayer use cases.

sources.title: Android local network permission
sources.finding: Android 17 enforces local-network protections for target SDK 37+; broad access uses ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK. Android 16 has an opt-in path. Apply OS/target-aware behavior.

sources.title: Unity 6.3 Android build process
sources.finding: Android build profile can produce APK and Build and Run with Android dependencies installed.

sources.title: Unity Screen.safeArea
sources.finding: Returns safe screen rectangle; phone controls need actual layout/device checks.

sources.title: Apple TN3111 Wi-Fi API overview
sources.finding: Apple proprietary peer-to-peer Wi-Fi is Apple-only. Newer Wi-Fi Aware is not the iPadOS 18 baseline. Earlier research also read official DocC JSON.

sources.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra SM-S948U1 update record
sources.finding: Confirms model name. Published Android 16 firmware does not prove installed OS on user phone.
